subject.title: fix chat-state recovery and archive propagation

question: Should the repository accept the durable replay-intent protocol and its migration-23/24 compatibility handoff as the supported upgrade contract for chat-state recovery?
rationale: The evidence supports correctness and real behavior, but choosing a persistent recovery-debt lifecycle and pre-release schema reconciliation is a long-term compatibility decision rather than a mechanical patch adjustment.

options.title: Accept the recovery contract
options.body: Merge after confirming that durable replay debt and the one-time marker-to-intent migration are the intended supported behavior for existing stores.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different durable-recovery or migration policy before changing persisted state.

recommendation.title: Accept the recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming that durable replay debt and the one-time marker-to-intent migration are the intended supported behavior for existing stores.
